rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a gallery displaying or conserving works of art.

example.english: This gallery is exhibiting many works by local artists.
example.traditional: 呢間藝廊展出好多本地藝術家嘅作品。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 ngai6 long4 zin2 ceot1 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 ge3 zok3 ban2

rows.note: Use this for an online or digital collection of images that users can browse.

example.english: This gallery has lots of free photos for people to download.
example.traditional: 呢個圖片庫有好多免費相片畀人下載。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou4 pin2 fu3 jau5 hou2 do1 min5 fai3 soeng2 pin3 bei2 jan4 haa6 zoi3

rows.note: Use this when “the gallery” means the spectators or public watching an event.

example.english: The gallery immediately stood up and applauded.
example.traditional: 觀眾即刻企晒起身鼓掌。
example.jyutping: gun1 zung3 zik1 hak1 kei5 saai3 hei2 san1 gu2 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the public seating area in a courtroom.

example.english: The judge told the gallery to remain quiet.
example.traditional: 法官叫旁聽席保持安靜。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 giu3 pong4 teng1 zik6 bou2 ci4 on1 zing6
